'''Prak City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. The many skyscrapers of Prak City were said to look like the pointed fangs of some animal when seen from a distance. [[Cloud car/Legends|Cloud cars]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] were common forms of transportation, as the land terrain was difficult to navigate. The city served as the seat of power for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Foga Brill/Legends|Foga Brill]], and many other companies established headquarters in the business district. Prak City was situated on the largest plateau on all of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]], allowing plenty of land to house a huge, Imperial-class [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The [[Asonel Caves|Asonel]] cave system ran through the mountains just outside of the city border.
